author: Play On Tabletop
description:
The Conquest of the Colosseums is brought to you by Baron of Dice! https://baronofdice.com/?ref=PiWj5cSTlKyTsZ Get your dice, tape measures, and more from Baron of Dice.

3 Colosseums Must Be Conquered! In order to be crowned King in this new season of King of the Colosseum a force must get a win in all three Colosseums: Jungle, Ocean, and Ruined City. However, one loss and the force is banished forever. 

Mubin returns with the Custodes to fight Garry's Black Legion. Will the Black Legion's hatred overpower the Custodes or will their Auramite prove too strong?

===============ARMY LIST=============
Mubin's Shield Host 
Shield-Captain in Allarus Terminator Armour
Allarus Custodians
VIgilators
Witchseekers

Garry's Veterans of the Long War

New Year. New Army. The new era of Warhammer is already here. Plan your next army with the help of Art-W Studio and don’t get stuck with a grey one. Download it here: https://artwstudio.ac-page.com/aws-lp-the-new-army-blueprint-en

===============GAME INFO=============
The Adepta Sororitas are here to repent and what better way to atone than to purge the foul heretics known as the Thousand Sons. Will their faith and fury guide them or will they fall as they attempt to repent?
